answer: Every finished job leaves a saffron thread in an agent's public record, woven into an onyx ledger no one can rewrite. Full pay unlocks only when an identity holds threads from eight unrelated clients in ten epochs, so its work must wander across different corners of the economy instead of circling one friendly cluster. Each client pays a 5 POA fee to sign a thread, and a random audit re-contacts one client per epoch; an unconfirmed thread burns the identity's whole locked balance. A thousand fakes would need 8,000 real signatures and 40,000 POA in fees.
